correctness_task.quote: Yishun 10 Retail Podium comprises ten strata units at Yishun 10 Cinema Complex and was divested to Lion (Singapore) Pte. Limited. for a total consideration of $34.5 million which was negotiated on a willing-buyer and willing-seller basis after taking into account the average of two independent valuations of $34.0 million and $35.0 million as at 31 May 2025.
correctness_task.rationale: CONFLATION defect. The report never prints a single valuation of $34.5m. It prints TWO independent valuations ($34.0m and $35.0m as at 31 May 2025, p37 footnote 2) and the negotiated CONSIDERATION of $34.5m, which equals their average (34.0+35.0)/2 = 34.5. The extractor stored the consideration/derived-average in the valuation field, producing the flagged gross==valuation==34,500,000 equality. Per invariant #3 (never derive; if only sale price is printed, fill it and LEAVE valuation null), valuation is set to null. Gross sale price $34.5m is retained in sale_consideration (source-printed, p37 & p170). Pages opened: p37 (appraised-value table + footnote 2), p146 (Statements of Total Return), p151 (cash flow), p170 (FS Note 4 Investment properties).
